picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE-funded project to build a foundation model for the U.S. electric grid shows AI research directly targeting critical national infrastructure resilience.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative extends the Genesis Mission's reach into critical minerals extraction, pairing academia, industry, and government on strategic resource security.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant to Notre Dame will bring AI weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers worldwide, a concrete real-world deployment of AI for global food security.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, signaling how quickly major universities are institutionalizing generative AI.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million naming gift establishing a dedicated AI and analytics college at UNT reflects growing philanthropic investment in building out AI-focused academic infrastructure.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models with precision, a meaningful step toward making generative design tools practically usable for manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology achieves 100x efficiency gains for edge AI hardware, a hardware-level breakthrough that could reshape how AI runs on smart devices.

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot making data-centre AI workloads dynamically grid-aware tackles the mounting energy strain from AI infrastructure growth, a pressing systemic issue for the field.
